errors.text_span: on geometry problems and tree width for rollout search
errors.evidence: This information is not present in the visual elements of the chart itself (axes, labels, data) but is taken from the accompanying paper caption. A description of the figure should be based on what is visually represented.
The description of the GPT-4o line omits the data point at a tree width of 3, where the accuracy is 28.9%.

errors.text_span: decreases to 20.0% at a tree width of 7
errors.evidence: This is an inaccurate oversimplification of the trend for the Claude-3.5-Sonnet line. The line first increases from 26.7% (at width 1) to 27.8% (at width 3) before it starts to decrease. Stating it simply "decreases" is misleading.
The description fails to mention the presence of a legend at the top of the chart, which identifies the lines corresponding to GPT-4o and Claude-3.5-Sonnet.
